title: 网孔电流法：含电流控制电压源
statement: 图示电路中 U_s = 12 V，R_1 = 2 Ω，R_2 = 4 Ω，R_3 = 2 Ω。右侧电流控制电压源（CCVS）的电压为 2i_x（“+”在下方），i_x 是 R_2 中向下的电流。网孔电流 i_m1（左）、i_m2（右）均取**顺时针**方向。
用**网孔电流法**求 i_m1、i_x，以及受控源吸收的功率。

questions.ask: i_m1 = ?（等于图中 R_1 的电流 i_1）
questions.explain: 代入 i_x = i_m1 − i_m2 后，网孔 2 的方程变为 −6i_m1 + 8i_m2 = 0，与 6i_m1 − 4i_m2 = 12 联立得 i_m1 = 4 A、i_m2 = 3 A。

questions.ask: 受控源 H 吸收的功率 P = ?
questions.explain: H 的电压 2i_x = 2 V（下正上负），电流 i_m2 = 3 A 从下往上流过它、从“+”端流出：P = −2 × 3 = −6 W（发出 6 W）。

questions.ask: 含受控源时，网孔方程的系数矩阵通常……
choices: 仍然对称，因为互电阻 R_12 = R_21
不再对称，因为受控源项移到左边后改变了系数
choiceExplain: R_12 = R_21 只对只含电阻和独立源的电路成立；含受控源时，要看受控源项移到左边后两个互电阻系数是否还相等。
对角矩阵要求网孔之间没有公共支路；这里 R_2 是公共支路，互电阻不为零。
行列式为零意味着方程没有唯一解；本题的网孔方程解出了唯一的 i_m1、i_m2，系数矩阵并不奇异。
questions.explain: 把 2i_x = 2(i_m1 − i_m2) 移到方程左边后，网孔 2 方程中 i_m1 的系数变成 −6，而网孔 1 方程中 i_m2 的系数是 −4，矩阵不再对称。

hints: 先把 CCVS 当作电压为 2i_x 的独立电压源列网孔方程，再补充控制量方程 i_x = i_m1 − i_m2。
顺时针绕网孔 2 经过 H 时是从“−”到“+”，即电压升 2i_x，写在方程右边。
solution: **5. 受控源功率：** u_H = 2i_x = 2 V（下正），电流 3 A 从“+”端流出：P = **−6 W**（发出 6 W）。

en.title: Mesh analysis with a current-controlled voltage source
statement: In the circuit, U_s = 12 V, R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = 4 Ω, R_3 = 2 Ω. The current-controlled voltage source (CCVS) on the right has voltage 2i_x ("+" at the bottom), where i_x is the downward current in R_2. The mesh currents i_m1 (left) and i_m2 (right) are both **clockwise**.
Use the **mesh-current method** to find i_m1, i_x and the power absorbed by the dependent source.

questions.ask: i_m1 = ? (equal to the current i_1 in R_1 shown in the figure)
questions.explain: With i_x = i_m1 − i_m2 the mesh-2 equation becomes −6i_m1 + 8i_m2 = 0; together with 6i_m1 − 4i_m2 = 12 it gives i_m1 = 4 A and i_m2 = 3 A.

questions.ask: Power absorbed by the dependent source H, P = ?
questions.explain: H has voltage 2i_x = 2 V (+ at the bottom); the current i_m2 = 3 A flows up through it and leaves at "+": P = −2 × 3 = −6 W (it delivers 6 W).

questions.ask: With a dependent source, the coefficient matrix of the mesh equations is usually…
choices: still symmetric, because the mutual resistances satisfy R_12 = R_21
no longer symmetric, because moving the dependent-source term to the left changes the coefficients
choiceExplain: R_12 = R_21 holds only for circuits of resistors and independent sources; with a dependent source you must check whether the two mutual coefficients still match once its term is moved to the left.
A diagonal matrix needs meshes with no shared branch; here R_2 is shared, so the mutual resistance is not zero.
A zero determinant would mean no unique solution; here the mesh equations give unique values of i_m1 and i_m2, so the matrix is not singular.
questions.explain: After moving 2i_x = 2(i_m1 − i_m2) to the left-hand side, the coefficient of i_m1 in the mesh-2 equation becomes −6, while the coefficient of i_m2 in the mesh-1 equation is −4: the matrix is no longer symmetric.

hints: First treat the CCVS as an independent voltage source of value 2i_x when writing the mesh equations, then add the controlling-variable equation i_x = i_m1 − i_m2.
Going clockwise around mesh 2 you cross H from "−" to "+": a rise of 2i_x, which goes on the right-hand side.
solution: **3. Controlling-variable equation:** i_x = i_m1 − i_m2. Substituting: −4i_m1 + 6i_m2 = 2i_m1 − 2i_m2 → −6i_m1 + 8i_m2 = 0 → i_m1 = (4/3)i_m2.
**5. Dependent-source power:** u_H = 2i_x = 2 V (+ at the bottom), and 3 A leaves at "+": P = **−6 W** (delivers 6 W).
**Check:** U_s delivers 12 × 4 = 48 W and H delivers 6 W, 54 W in total; the resistors absorb 2×16 + 4×1 + 2×9 = 32 + 4 + 18 = 54 W.
